arguments.content: Destination reader migration compatibility: P1 found in staged reader.py cleanup. A writer emitting only nested destination.address does not establish that stored records have migrated. Where migration is bounded and reads remain available without a startup gate, readers must accept both legacy top-level address and the new shape until completion is guaranteed. Removing this compatibility path makes api.list_destinations fail for the whole list when one unmigrated row remains. Existing tests for new writes and empty input pass despite the outage. Verified against the repository's supported mixed data/records.json snapshot: listing fails before migration and after one limit=1 batch, then succeeds after all legacy rows migrate. Review/removal precondition: prove migration completion and exclusion of legacy records, with mixed-snapshot and partial-batch read coverage.
